question:
What are the components of CPU?

[UPASI 05.12.2021 (Shift-II)]
options: Output devices such as monitor and printer
External storage devices such as floppy and pen drive
Input devices such as keyboard and mouse
Control Unit and ALU
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Control Unit and ALU

Explanation:
The CPU (Central Processing Unit) is the main processing component of a computer, often referred to as the computer's 'brain'. Its two primary components are the Control Unit (CU) and the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU). The Control Unit directs and coordinates all computer operations. It fetches instructions from memory, decodes them, and then directs the ALU to execute them. The ALU performs all arithmetic operations like addition, subtraction and logical operations like AND, OR, NOT. Monitors, keyboards, etc., are peripheral devices and are not internal components of the CPU.

Extra Facts:
Understanding the Instruction Cycle is crucial for comprehending CPU functions, which includes the Fetch, Decode, and Execute stages. A third critical component in modern CPUs is Registers, which are high-speed memory used for temporary storage of data and instructions. CPU speed is measured in Megahertz (MHz) or Gigahertz (GHz). Multi-core processors contain more than one CPU on a single chip, enhancing processing power and efficiency.

question_hi:
सी.पी.यू. (CPU) के घटक कौन-से हैं?

[UPASI 05.12.2021 (Shift-II)]
options_hi: मॉनिटर और प्रिंटर जैसे आउटपुट डिवाइसेस

solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है कंट्रोल यूनिट और ए.एल.यू. (ALU)

Explanation:
सीपीयू (Central Processing Unit) कंप्यूटर का मुख्य प्रसंस्करण घटक है, जिसे कंप्यूटर का 'मस्तिष्क' कहा जाता है। इसके दो प्रमुख घटक हैं: कंट्रोल यूनिट (Control Unit - CU) और अरिथमेटिक लॉजिक यूनिट (Arithmetic Logic Unit - ALU)। कंट्रोल यूनिट कंप्यूटर के सभी ऑपरेशन्स को निर्देशित (coordinate) और नियंत्रित (control) करती है। यह मेमोरी से निर्देशों को फ़ेच (fetch) करती है, उन्हें डिकोड (decode) करती है और फिर निष्पादन के लिए ALU को निर्देशित करती है। ALU सभी अंकगणितीय (Arithmetic) जैसे जोड़, घटाव और तार्किक (Logical) जैसे AND, OR, NOT ऑपरेशन्स को संपन्न करती है। मॉनिटर, कीबोर्ड आदि बाह्य उपकरण हैं, जो सीपीयू के आंतरिक घटक नहीं हैं।

Extra Facts:
सीपीयू के कार्यों को समझने के लिए निर्देश चक्र (Instruction Cycle) का ज्ञान महत्वपूर्ण है, जिसमें फ़ेच (Fetch), डिकोड (Decode), और एक्ज़िक्यूट (Execute) चरण शामिल हैं। आधुनिक सीपीयू में एक तीसरा महत्वपूर्ण घटक रजिस्टर (Registers) भी होता है, जो डेटा और निर्देशों को अस्थायी रूप से संग्रहीत करने के लिए उच्च-गति वाली मेमोरी है। सीपीयू की गति मेगाहर्ट्ज़ (MHz) या गीगाहर्ट्ज़ (GHz) में मापी जाती है। मल्टी-कोर प्रोसेसर एक ही चिप पर एक से अधिक सीपीयू रखते हैं, जिससे प्रसंस्करण क्षमता और कार्यक्षमता बढ़ जाती है।

question:
ALU is a part of a computer is............

[SSC 10+2 CHSL 02.02.17, 1.15 pm]
options: Application
ROM
RAM
Processor
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Processor

Explanation:
ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) is a core component of a computer's processor (CPU). It performs all arithmetic calculations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) and logical operations (AND, OR, NOT). The processor consists of three main components: ALU, Control Unit, and Registers. ALU directly receives instructions from the Control Unit and performs operations on data. Other options like Application (software), ROM (Read-Only Memory), and RAM (Random Access Memory) are not parts of the processor but rather other components of the computer system.

Extra Facts:
The CPU (Central Processing Unit) is called the brain of the computer. It processes all instructions. Besides ALU, the Control Unit decodes instructions and controls various system components. Registers are used for temporary data storage. In computer architecture, the Von Neumann Architecture is fundamental, defining data flow between CPU, memory, and I/O devices.

solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है प्रोसेसर

Explanation:
ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) कंप्यूटर के प्रोसेसर (CPU) का एक मुख्य घटक है। यह सभी अंकगणितीय गणनाएँ (जोड़, घटाव, गुणा, भाग) और तार्किक संचालन (AND, OR, NOT) करता है। प्रोसेसर के तीन मुख्य भाग होते हैं: ALU, Control Unit और Registers। ALU सीधे कंट्रोल यूनिट से निर्देश प्राप्त करता है और डेटा पर संचालन करता है। अन्य विकल्प जैसे एप्लीकेशन (सॉफ्टवेयर), ROM (रीड-ओनली मेमोरी), और RAM (रैंडम एक्सेस मेमोरी) प्रोसेसर के भाग नहीं हैं, बल्कि कंप्यूटर सिस्टम के अन्य घटक हैं।

Extra Facts:
CPU (Central Processing Unit) को कंप्यूटर का दिमाग कहा जाता है। यह सभी निर्देशों को प्रोसेस करता है। ALU के अलावा, Control Unit निर्देशों को डिकोड करती है और सिस्टम के विभिन्न भागों को नियंत्रित करती है। Registers अस्थायी डेटा स्टोरेज के लिए उपयोग होते हैं। कंप्यूटर आर्किटेक्चर में वॉन न्यूमैन आर्किटेक्चर मौलिक है, जो CPU, मेमोरी और I/O डिवाइस के बीच डेटा प्रवाह को परिभाषित करता है।

question:
What does POST stand for in the context of computers?

[UPSSSC X-Ray Technician 15.12.2024]
options: Power-On Self-Test
Power-On System Test
Post-Operating System Test
Pre-Operating System Test
None of the above
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Power-On Self-Test

Explanation:
POST stands for Power-On Self-Test. It is a crucial part of the computer's start-up process managed by the BIOS (Basic Input/Output System). When you turn on the computer, POST automatically performs a basic check of hardware components such as RAM, CPU, hard disk, keyboard, and other devices. It ensures that all hardware is functioning properly and there are no critical errors before the operating system loads. If POST is successful, the computer continues with the boot process; otherwise, it indicates the problem through beep codes or error messages.

Extra Facts:
BIOS is a firmware stored on a ROM (Read-Only Memory) chip on the motherboard. The POST process acts as a vital link between hardware and software. In modern computers, UEFI (Unified Extensible Firmware Interface) has replaced traditional BIOS, but the functionality of POST remains essentially the same. It helps ensure system reliability and early detection of hardware failures.

Explanation:
POST का पूरा नाम Power-On Self-Test है। यह कंप्यूटर के स्टार्ट-अप प्रक्रिया का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा है जो BIOS (Basic Input/Output System) द्वारा संचालित होता है। जब आप कंप्यूटर चालू करते हैं, तो POST स्वचालित रूप से हार्डवेयर घटकों जैसे RAM, CPU, हार्ड डिस्क, कीबोर्ड और अन्य डिवाइसों की बुनियादी जांच करता है। यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि सभी हार्डवेयर ठीक से काम कर रहे हैं और ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम लोड होने से पहले कोई महत्वपूर्ण त्रुटि नहीं है। यदि POST सफल होता है, तो कंप्यूटर आगे की बूट प्रक्रिया जारी रखता है, अन्यथा यह बीप कोड या त्रुटि संदेश देकर समस्या का संकेत देता है।

Extra Facts:
BIOS एक फर्मवेयर है जो मदरबोर्ड पर स्थित ROM (Read-Only Memory) चिप में संग्रहीत होता है। POST प्रक्रिया हार्डवेयर और सॉफ्टवेयर के बीच एक महत्वपूर्ण कड़ी है। आधुनिक कंप्यूटरों में UEFI (Unified Extensible Firmware Interface) ने पारंपरिक BIOS का स्थान ले लिया है, लेकिन POST की कार्यप्रणाली मूल रूप से समान रहती है। यह सिस्टम की विश्वसनीयता सुनिश्चित करने और हार्डवेयर विफलताओं का शीघ्र पता लगाने में मदद करता है।

question:
Which part of the CPU selects, interprets, and monitors the execution of program instructions?

[S.S.C. संयुक्त स्नातक स्तरीय (Tier-I) परीक्षा, 2014]
options: Memory
Register unit
Control unit
ALU
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Control unit

Explanation:
The Control Unit of the CPU is the critical component responsible for selecting, interpreting, and monitoring the execution of program instructions. It acts as the brain of the computer's Central Processing Unit, decoding instructions, controlling data flow between the ALU and registers, and generating timing signals. The Control Unit manages the fetch-decode-execute cycle, ensuring each instruction is executed in the correct sequence and at the proper time. It coordinates with memory and input/output devices, enabling the computer's entire operation to run smoothly and efficiently.

Extra Facts:
The CPU consists of three main components: Control Unit, ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit), and registers. The ALU performs mathematical and logical operations, while registers provide temporary data storage. Instruction Register (IR) and Program Counter (PC) are crucial registers for the Control Unit. The Control Unit is an integral part of the microprocessor, and without it, a computer cannot execute instructions independently. Modern CPUs have significantly improved Control Unit functionality through techniques like pipelining and parallel processing, enhancing overall processing efficiency.

Explanation:
सीपीयू का कंट्रोल यूनिट वह महत्वपूर्ण घटक है जो प्रोग्राम के अनुदेशों के निष्पादन का चयन, निर्वचन (इंटरप्रेट) और मॉनीटर करने का कार्य करता है। यह कंप्यूटर के सेंट्रल प्रोसेसिंग यूनिट का मस्तिष्क कहलाता है जो निर्देशों को डीकोड करता है, एएलयू और रजिस्टर्स के बीच डेटा फ्लो को नियंत्रित करता है, और टाइमिंग सिग्नल जनरेट करता है। कंट्रोल यूनिट फेच-डीकोड-एक्जीक्यूट साइकिल को मैनेज करके यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि प्रत्येक निर्देश सही क्रम में और सही समय पर निष्पादित हो। यह मेमोरी और इनपुट/आउटपुट डिवाइसों के साथ समन्वय स्थापित करता है, जिससे कंप्यूटर का संपूर्ण ऑपरेशन सुचारू रूप से चलता है।

Extra Facts:
सीपीयू के तीन मुख्य घटक होते हैं: कंट्रोल यूनिट, एएलयू (अरिथमेटिक लॉजिक यूनिट) और रजिस्टर्स। एएलयू गणितीय और तार्किक ऑपरेशन करता है, जबकि रजिस्टर्स अस्थायी डेटा स्टोरेज प्रदान करते हैं। निर्देश रजिस्टर (IR) और प्रोग्राम काउंटर (PC) कंट्रोल यूनिट के महत्वपूर्ण रजिस्टर्स हैं। कंट्रोल यूनिट माइक्रोप्रोसेसर का अभिन्न अंग है और इसके बिना कंप्यूटर स्वतंत्र रूप से निर्देश निष्पादित नहीं कर सकता। आधुनिक सीपीयू में पाइपलाइनिंग और पैरेलल प्रोसेसिंग तकनीकों के माध्यम से कंट्रोल यूनिट की कार्यक्षमता में significant improvement की गई है।

question:
An electronic path that connects one part of a computer to another is:

[Allahabad High Court (RO) 11/12/2022 (Shift-II)]
options: Logic Gate
Serial Port
Modem
Bus
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Bus

Explanation:
A bus is an electronic pathway that connects different components of a computer such as the CPU, memory, and input/output devices. It facilitates the transfer of data, addresses, and control signals between these components. The width and speed of a bus significantly impact computer performance. While a serial port and modem are used for connecting external devices, and a logic gate is a fundamental building block of digital circuits, the specific function of "connecting one part of a computer to another" is precisely what a bus does.

Extra Facts:
There are three main types of buses: data bus, address bus, and control bus. The data bus transfers data, the address bus specifies memory locations, and the control bus manages operations. Modern bus standards include PCI, USB, and SATA. The bus architecture determines a computer's efficiency and expandability. The system bus connects the processor to main memory, while an expansion bus is for additional peripherals.

question:
The three main parts of the processor are:

[Allahabad High Court (RO) 11/12/2022 (Shift-II)]
options: ALU, Control Unit and Registers
ALU, Control Unit and RAM
Cache, Control Unit and Registers
Control Unit, Registers and RAM
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is ALU, Control Unit and Registers

Explanation:
The processor, also known as the Central Processing Unit (CPU), is the brain of the computer. Its three main components are the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU), the Control Unit (CU), and the Registers. The ALU performs all arithmetic calculations and logical operations. The Control Unit controls and coordinates the flow of data between all of the computer's resources, such as input/output devices, memory, and the ALU. It decodes instructions and oversees their execution. Registers are small, extremely fast memory locations inside the CPU that temporarily store the instructions and data currently being executed. These three components work together to fetch, decode, and execute the instructions of any program.

Extra Facts:
The operation of the CPU is known as the Fetch-Decode-Execute cycle. RAM (Random Access Memory) and Cache are not core parts of the processor itself; they are memory units. RAM is the main memory, while Cache is a small, ultra-fast memory located between the CPU and RAM to provide quick access to frequently used data. The speed of a processor is measured in Hertz (Hz), which indicates the number of cycles per second. Modern processors use multi-core technology, which means there is more than one processing unit on a single chip.

question:
Which of the following facts about the control unit of a computer is false?

[UPPCL Executive Assistant 21-11-2022 Shift-I]
options: It retrieves instructions from memory, interprets them, and directs the computer's operations.
It processes and stores data.
It manages and coordinates all units of the computer.
It is responsible for controlling the transfer of data and instructions between other units of the computer.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is It processes and stores data.

Explanation:
The Control Unit is a crucial component of the CPU that manages all computer operations. It retrieves instructions from memory, interprets them, and coordinates between different parts of the computer like the ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit), memory, and I/O devices. However, processing and storing data is not the function of the Control Unit – this is handled by the ALU and memory units. The primary purpose of the Control Unit is to regulate the flow of data and instructions between various system components, not to perform data processing or storage itself.

Extra Facts:
The Control Unit and ALU together form the CPU (Central Processing Unit). The Control Unit plays a central role in computer architecture, operating according to the Instruction Set Architecture (ISA). It synchronizes all operations using clock signals. There are two types of Control Units: Hardwired Control Unit (controlled by fixed logic circuits) and Microprogrammed Control Unit (controlled by microprograms). It plays a vital role in managing the computer's fetch-decode-execute cycle.

question:
Which material is used to manufacture Computer Chips?

[UPP Computer Operator 21-12-2018 (Batch-01)]
options: Silver
Iron
Gold
Semiconductor
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Semiconductor

Explanation:
Semiconductor materials are used in the manufacturing of computer chips. Semiconductors are materials that have electrical conductivity between conductors and insulators. Silicon is the most widely used semiconductor material, being the second most abundant element in the Earth's crust. These materials are given specific electrical properties through a process called doping, which enables the creation of transistors, diodes, and integrated circuits. These microscopic components collectively form microprocessors and memory chips that serve as the foundation of computer CPUs and other electronic devices.

Extra Facts:
Semiconductor technology follows Moore's Law, which states that the number of transistors on a chip doubles approximately every two years. Germanium is another important semiconductor material. Modern chip manufacturing uses nanometer process technologies. VLSI technology enables millions of transistors to be incorporated on a single small chip. The semiconductor industry forms the backbone of the computer hardware industry and has been the foundation of the digital revolution.

question:
The register which holds the address of location of memory to and from which data are to be transferred is known as

[BPSC TRE 2.0 Exam-2023 (11-12)]
options: index register
memory address register
memory buffer register
More than one of the above
None of the above
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is memory address register

Explanation:
The Memory Address Register (MAR) is a special CPU register that stores the address of the memory location from which data is to be read or to which data is to be written. When the CPU needs to access data from memory, the address of the specific memory cell is loaded into the MAR. It plays a crucial role in controlling data transfer between memory and CPU. The Index Register stores offsets for memory addresses, while the Memory Buffer Register (MBR) holds the actual data being transferred. The size of MAR depends on the width of the address bus in the system and forms the foundation of memory management in computer architecture.

Extra Facts:
In computer architecture, registers are high-speed memory locations used by the CPU for data processing. The Program Counter (PC) stores the address of the next instruction to be executed, while the Accumulator stores results of arithmetic and logical operations. Register size significantly impacts computer performance - 32-bit systems can address up to 4GB of memory, while 64-bit systems support much larger address spaces. This concept is fundamental in Von Neumann architecture for data transfer between memory and processor.

question:
Which of the following languages can a computer understand directly?

[UPPCL Executive Assistant 2022]
options: Low-level
Medium level
High-level
Object level
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Low-level

Explanation:
Computers can only understand low-level languages directly, specifically machine language which is written in pure binary code (0s and 1s). This language can be executed directly by the CPU as it operates at the hardware level. High-level languages like Python, Java require compilers or interpreters to convert them into machine language. There are no standard categories like medium level or object level - these are only used for classification purposes. The computer's internal architecture can only process binary instructions, making low-level language the only option that computers can understand without translation.

Extra Facts:
Low-level languages include machine language and assembly language. Assembly language is converted to machine code by an assembler. High-level languages use human-readable syntax and are portable. Compilers translate the entire program at once while interpreters translate line-by-line. This layer between hardware and software is a crucial part of system software. The evolution of programming languages has been driven by the need to simplify computer programming for humans.

solution:

question:
Which of the following CPU registers is used to store data and intermediate results produced by the ALU?

[NVS Ju. Sect. Asst. 09.03.2022 (Shift-I)]
options: Program counter
Memory address register
Accumulator
Instruction register
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Accumulator

Explanation:
The Accumulator is a CPU register primarily used to store data and intermediate results produced by the ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit). When the ALU performs calculations such as addition, subtraction, or comparisons, the result is temporarily stored in the accumulator. It is a crucial component of the CPU because it makes the execution cycle more efficient by reducing the need to repeatedly access the main memory. The other options serve different purposes: the Program Counter stores the address of the next instruction, the Memory Address Register holds the address of a memory location, and the Instruction Register stores the instruction currently being executed.

Extra Facts:
CPU registersmemory locations located inside the processor that temporarily hold data, instructions, or addresses. The ALU is the part of the CPU that performs all arithmetic (addition, subtraction, etc.) and logical (AND, OR, NOT, etc.) operations. The presence of registers improves computer performance by reducing memory access time. The Control Unit manages the flow of data between these registers. The size of registers (e.g., 32-bit, 64-bit) helps determine the data processing capability of the CPU.

question:
Where do the operations of adding, comparing, and matching take place in a computer?

options: Memory chip
CPU chip
Floppy disk
Hard disk
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is CPU chip

Explanation:
In a computer, the operations of adding, comparing, and matching take place in the CPU (Central Processing Unit) chip. The CPU is often called the brain of the computer, and these calculations and logical operations are performed by its component called the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU). While a memory chip (RAM/ROM) is responsible for temporarily or permanently storing data and instructions, and floppy disks and hard disks are secondary storage devices used for long-term data storage, they do not perform the actual processing. Thus, all computational activities are centralized in the CPU.

Extra Facts:
The CPU is primarily composed of three components: the ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit), the CU (Control Unit), and Registers. The ALU performs all arithmetic (like addition, subtraction) and logical operations (like comparison, matching). The CU controls the execution of instructions among all other computer components. The speed of a CPU is measured in Hertz (Hz). Modern computers feature multi-core processors, which provide the ability to process multiple tasks simultaneously, significantly enhancing performance.

question:
Which of the following statements about ALU is incorrect?

[UPPCL Executive Assistant 2022]
options: ALU uses CPU registers for operations.
ALU is one of the main components of the CPU.
ALU controls the functions of the control unit.
ALU performs both arithmetic and logic operations.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is ALU controls the functions of the control unit.

Explanation:
The ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) is a core component of the CPU responsible for performing all arithmetic (addition, subtraction, etc.) and logic (AND, OR, NOT, etc.) operations. It uses CPU registers for its operations. However, the statement that the ALU controls the functions of the Control Unit is incorrect. In fact, the opposite is true; the Control Unit (CU) is the component that directs and coordinates the operations of all parts of the CPU, including the ALU. The Control Unit fetches instructions from memory, decodes them, and then sends signals to the ALU to execute them. Therefore, the claim that the ALU controls the Control Unit is fundamentally wrong.

Extra Facts:
The CPU (Central Processing Unit) is often called the brain of the computer and consists of three main components: the ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit), the CU (Control Unit), and Registers. The ALU performs actual calculations on data, while the CU manages all operations. Registers are high-speed memory locations used for temporary data storage, which the ALU utilizes. A computer's performance is often measured by its CPU's clock speed (e.g., in GHz) and the efficiency of its ALU. Modern CPUs often feature multiple ALU cores, enabling parallel processing for faster computation.

सी.पी.यू (सेंट्रल प्रोसेसिंग यूनिट) कंप्यूटर का मुख्य प्रसंस्करण घटक है जिसे कंप्यूटर का 'मस्तिष्क' कहा जाता है। सी.पी.यू के मुख्य घटकों में एरिथमैटिक लॉजिक यूनिट (ALU) (जो सभी अंकगणितीय और तार्किक संक्रियाएं करती है), कंट्रोल यूनिट (CU) (जो सभी संचालनों को नियंत्रित करती है), और मेमोरी यूनिट/रजिस्टर्स (जो अस्थायी डेटा संग्रहण के लिए होते हैं) शामिल हैं। इनपुट यूनिट सी.पी.यू का भाग नहीं है, बल्कि यह एक बाह्य उपकरण है जो कंप्यूटर में डेटा प्रविष्ट करने का कार्य करता है, जैसे कीबोर्ड, माउस आदि। यह सी.पी.यू के मूल कार्यक्षेत्र से बाहर का घटक है।

Extra Facts:

कंप्यूटर प्रोसेस डाटा को इन्फार्मेशन में परिवर्तित करता है। डाटा कच्चे तथ्यों और आंकड़ों का संग्रह होता है जो अपने मूल रूप में अर्थपूर्ण नहीं होता। जब कंप्यूटर इस डाटा को प्रोसेस करता है - जिसमें सॉर्टिंग, कैलकुलेशन, एनालिसिस जैसे ऑपरेशन शामिल होते हैं - तो यह इन्फार्मेशन में बदल जाता है। इन्फार्मेशन वह संदर्भित और संरचित डाटा होता है जो निर्णय लेने में सहायक होता है। यह कंप्यूटर सिस्टम के मूल कार्य - इनपुट, प्रोसेस, आउटपुट - को दर्शाता है, जहाँ इनपुट डाटा होता है, प्रोसेसिंग के बाद आउटपुट इन्फार्मेशन मिलता है।

question:
The most common addressing technique employed by a CPU is

[BPSC TRE 1.0 Exam-2023 (11-12)]
options: direct
indirect
immediate
More than one of the above
None of the above
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is More than one of the above

Explanation:
The most common addressing techniques employed by a CPU are direct, indirect, and immediate addressing modes. Direct addressing specifies the operand's address directly, indirect addressing provides the address of the operand's address, and immediate addressing includes the operand within the instruction itself. All three are extensively used in CPU architectures and are fundamental for memory management and instruction execution. Knowledge of these in programming and assembly language is crucial for efficient code writing, forming a core part of computer architecture.

Extra Facts:
Addressing modes are vital for CPUs as they are part of the instruction set architecture. Indexed and relative addressing are other key modes. Their implementation varies in CISC and RISC architectures. They directly impact memory hierarchy and cache performance. Their role in operating systems and compiler design is essential for optimization, linking to core computer science concepts.

question:
Which of the following in the basis of computer and holds all of the circuit that ties the different components of the computer system together?

[UPPCL AC 2019 (Exam Date 29.01.2019)]
options: Hard Disk Drive
Motherboard
CPU
Cable
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Motherboard

Explanation:
The motherboard serves as the fundamental basis of a computer that holds all circuits and connects different components together. It is a printed circuit board (PCB) that provides electrical connections for communication between CPU, RAM, hard drives, graphics cards and other peripheral devices. The motherboard contains chipsets, BIOS, expansion slots and power connectors. It controls data transfer between various components through data buses. Without a motherboard, different computer parts cannot communicate with each other effectively.

Extra Facts:
The motherboard acts as the computer's central nervous system coordinating all hardware components. BIOS (Basic Input/Output System) is firmware located on the motherboard that controls the computer's boot process. Modern motherboards provide advanced connectivity options like SATA, PCI-Express, USB and M.2. The motherboard's form factor (ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX) determines the computer case size and component compatibility. Different motherboard chipsets support specific processors and memory types.

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Peripheral Interface Controller

Explanation:
PIC microcontroller stands for Peripheral Interface Controller. It is a popular microcontroller family developed by Microchip Technology. A microcontroller is an integrated circuit that contains a CPU, RAM, ROM, and I/O ports on a single chip. PIC microcontrollers are widely used in embedded systems, automation, robotics, and consumer electronics. They are highly popular among engineers and hobbyists due to their low power consumption, affordable cost, and easy programming capabilities.

Extra Facts:
The main difference between a microcontroller and a microprocessor is that microcontrollers have all components integrated, while microprocessors require external components. PIC microcontrollers use Harvard architecture and can be programmed in assembly language or C language. They are also used in industrial control systems, medical devices, and automotive systems.
